``` { .yaml .annotate linenums="1" }
version: "3.7"
services:
  dockerautolabel:
    build: .
    image: davideshay/dockerautolabel:latest
    environment:
      - TZ=America/Los_Angeles
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /usr/share/zoneinfo
        target: /usr/share/zoneinfo
        read_only: true
      - /var/run/docker.sock:/var/run/docker.sock
    configs:
      - source: dockerautolabel_config
        target: /config/servicelist.txt
    deploy:
      mode: replicated
      replicas: 1
      placement:
        constraints: [ node.role == manager]

configs:
  dockerautolabel_config:  # (1)!
    file: ./servicelist.txt
    name: dockerautolabel_config_v4
```

1.  the service list is `servicelist.txt`, below, deployed as a swarm config. swarm refuses a
    deploy that changes a config's content under the same name, so each change to the list bumps
    the version suffix on the config's name.
